events.text: Erich Böhme hosted the last Talk im Turm programme for the Bundestag elections on 27 September 1998.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Böhme hosted the last Talk im Turm programme for the Bundestag elections on 27 September 1998

events.text: At the end of 1997 Böhme became co-host of Der Grüne Salon at the n-tv news channel.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: Already at the end of 1997 Böhme became co-host of the programme Der Grüne Salon

events.text: From 2000, Böhme continued a similar broadcasting format with Talk in Berlin.
